triage_candidates.statement: The handoff Close Criteria's literal test recipe for the byte-identical proof ('monkeypatch installer.REPO_ROOT ... so it resolves via the real default_mcp_config_path()') does not work as written: default_mcp_config_path(repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT) binds its default at def-time, so patching the REPO_ROOT module global afterward is inert for it, and patching REPO_ROOT itself separately breaks install_skills (which reads REPO_ROOT directly). Implementer worked around this correctly (patching default_mcp_config_path.__defaults__ instead, confirmed correct by this review) but flagged it in Workflow Feedback as worth fixing at the template level -- REPO_ROOT gates 3 other functions the same def-time-default way (validate_required_scripts, source_hook_path, discover_skills/SOURCE_ROOT), so the same handoff-recipe mistake would recur. Suggest updating the shared handoff/close-criteria template wording to name the __defaults__ patch pattern instead of a bare REPO_ROOT monkeypatch.
